headline: Latch Flares Again as Expanse and Shelf Churn
war_summary: Three hours later the wire brings fresh movement where silence had settled. Callahan's Passage, listed as quiet, now counts four changes in two hours and twenty in the day, all at The Latch, still held ten to none by the Wardens amid 6,636 Colonial and 5,705 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest desk with sixty changes in the day and three in two hours about Shattered Advance, Wightwalk and Frostmarch, now five Warden to four Colonial with no destroyed post, and 9,169 Colonial to 10,581 Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf shows five Warden, two Colonial and two destroyed after fifty-three daily changes and four in two hours at Breaker Town, Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. Linn Mercy with twelve changes, Marban Hollow with ten at Mox, Viper Pit with five at Blackthroat, Dead Lands with sixteen and Stonecradle in a five-to-four divide with nine changes have all logged nothing in the last two hours, while Godcrofts holds eight Colonial with one post destroyed after seventeen changes.
